system.description:
You extend both of your hands into the air, releasing a mass of Lightning chakra into the sky creating thunder clouds. This jutsu can only be cast while there is no ceiling or obstruction above you.

When this jutsu is cast and as a Bonus action on following turns, you can perform a Lightning Strike.

Lightning Strike. Select a point within range that you can see and call down lightning striking all creatures in a 5-foot radius centered of the select point forcing them all to make a Dexterity Saving throw, dealing 2d12 Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature can only be affected by Lightning Strike once per turn.

Overcharge. A creature who fails their saving throw, has their legs begins to seize up, reducing their walking speed to 5 feet, until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and select one additional target space. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage dealt by +1d12. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher creatures who fail their saving throw gain a rank of Shocked. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, a creature can be affected by a lightning strike up to twice per turn.
